summary: Frontend-only validation of PHASE 8B Sales Dashboard. Sales user landing at /dashboard renders the new SalesDashboard with header 'Sales Dashboard' and subtitle 'Performa & follow up milik Rina Sales'. All 15 KPI tiles (lead new/active/qualified/lost, quotation total/outstanding/converted/conversion, booking total/pax/sales, commission pax/tier/est/paid) render with real owner-scoped values (e.g. lead new=2, active=5, quotation total=16 conv=100%, booking total=13, pax=33, sales=Rp 1127.7jt, commission est=Rp 400.000). My Outstanding shows all 6 clickable tiles (out-leads, out-quotation, out-fu-today, out-fu-overdue, out-payment, out-departure) and all 4 charts render (recharts SVG count=4: Sales Trend line, Lead Funnel bar, Booking&Pax bar, Lead Source bar) plus package-performance table. No HPP/profit/cost/margin text present in Sales dashboard. Regression: Super Admin still lands on dashboard-page (original admin dashboard); Accounting also lands on dashboard-page and NOT sales-dashboard.

ui_bugs.issue: out-quotation navigated to /quotation (singular) and out-fu-today/out-fu-overdue navigated to /followups — routes don't exist so wildcard sent user back to /dashboard. Actual routes are /quotations and /follow-ups. FIXED in this iteration by testing agent.

issues: 4th slot placeholder shows a literal em dash (—) with empty value — cosmetic, should be removed or replaced with a real KPI

action_items: Dashboard.jsx (regression concern): the fallback `isSales` block for non-sales users who still hold sales.view (e.g. Super Admin) renders an inner grid with data-testid="sales-dashboard". This DUPLICATES the testid used by the new SalesDashboard.jsx. For Super Admin the page now has BOTH data-testid='dashboard-page' AND data-testid='sales-dashboard'. Since super_admin has all perms including sales.view, this may cause future test-id collisions. Recommend renaming the inner div (e.g. data-testid='sales-stats-grid') so only real Sales users show the top-level sales-dashboard.
Consider removing the empty '—' KPI placeholder in the Booking group of SalesDashboard.jsx or replacing it with a meaningful metric.
critical_code_review_comments: SalesDashboard.jsx hard-coded route strings (/quotation, /followups) did not match actual router paths (/quotations, /follow-ups). Suggest centralising route constants to avoid drift.
Duplicate data-testid='sales-dashboard' between Dashboard.jsx (inline sales-stats grid for isSales) and new SalesDashboard.jsx root causes ambiguous selectors for super_admin.
SalesDashboard.jsx uses `useAuth().user.name` without null-guard; safe today because the effect runs only after auth resolves, but a defensive fallback (`user?.name || ''`) would be safer.
No loading skeleton for chart cards — a single global spinner blocks the whole page; consider partial skeletons like Dashboard.jsx.
Sales dashboard error path returns 'Gagal memuat dashboard.' but no retry button.

context_for_next_testing_agent: PHASE 8B validated end-to-end from UI. All KPI/outstanding testids present. Fixed navigation routes in SalesDashboard.jsx (/quotation->/quotations, /followups->/follow-ups). One remaining concern: Dashboard.jsx still uses data-testid='sales-dashboard' on the admin fallback grid (for users with sales.view), which duplicates the id used by SalesDashboard.jsx. Not blocking, but rename recommended.
rca of the issue: Root cause: The My Outstanding tiles used route slugs (/quotation, /followups) that don't match the app's registered React Router paths (/quotations, /follow-ups). React Router's catch-all wildcard `<Route path="*" element={<Navigate to="/dashboard" replace />}/>` intercepted the unknown paths and redirected users back to the dashboard, making clicks appear as no-ops. Reproduction: login as sales, click Quotation outstanding tile, observe URL remains /dashboard. Mitigation: use exact route paths as defined in /app/frontend/src/config/nav.js (already applied).
